paper: Evaluating and Improving ChatGPT for Unit Test Generation
evidence_for_RQ: Directly reports compilation errors and execution failures in ChatGPT-generated unit tests and proposes ChatTester.
recommended_section: Core related work; justify compile+execute outcome and repair.

paper: An initial investigation of ChatGPT unit test generation capability
evidence_for_RQ: Early empirical study of ChatGPT's unit-test generation capability.

paper: ChatGPT vs SBST: A Comparative Assessment of Unit Test Suite Generation
evidence_for_RQ: Compares ChatGPT-generated suites with EvoSuite on correctness, coverage and bug detection.

paper: Using Large Language Models to Generate JUnit Tests: An Empirical Study
evidence_for_RQ: Uses HumanEval and SF110; evaluates compilation rates, correctness, coverage and test smells for Java/JUnit generation.
recommended_section: Strong methodology precedent for JUnit compilability and benchmark evaluation.

paper: On the Evaluation of Large Language Models in Unit Test Generation
evidence_for_RQ: Evaluates multiple LLMs and prompt settings on 17 Java projects with comprehensive metrics.
recommended_section: Methodology and Java project evaluation context.

paper: LLMs and Prompting for Unit Test Generation: A Large-Scale Evaluation
evidence_for_RQ: Large-scale empirical evaluation of prompting strategies for LLM unit-test generation.

paper: A System for Automated Unit Test Generation Using Large Language Models and Assessment of Generated Test Suites
evidence_for_RQ: Presents AgoneTest and Classes2Test for automated generation and comparison of human-written and LLM-generated Java tests.
recommended_section: Human baseline and automated evaluation precedent.

paper: LLMs for Automated Unit Test Generation and Assessment in Java: The AgoneTest Framework
evidence_for_RQ: Standardized end-to-end evaluation pipeline for LLM-generated Java unit tests; discusses results for tests that compile.
recommended_section: Evaluation pipeline design and compile-filtering precedent.

paper: YATE: The Role of Test Repair in LLM-Based Unit Test Generation
evidence_for_RQ: Directly studies repairing incorrect LLM-generated tests using static analysis and re-prompting.
recommended_section: Key evidence for one compiler-feedback repair round.

paper: Seed&Steer: Guiding Large Language Models with Compilable Prefix and Branch Signals for Unit Test Generation
evidence_for_RQ: Shows initialization complexity affects compilation success and reports compilation-pass improvements on Java projects.
recommended_section: Direct support for compilability as a primary outcome.

paper: TestLoter: A logic-driven framework for automated unit test generation and error repair using large language models
evidence_for_RQ: Uses a generate-repair framework; explicitly compiles and executes generated tests and repairs syntax/compilation errors.

paper: ASTER: Natural and Multi-language Unit Test Generation with LLMs
evidence_for_RQ: Pipeline combines static analysis and LLMs to generate compilable, high-coverage tests for Java and Python.

paper: CUBETESTERAI: Automated JUnit Test Generation using the LLaMA Model
evidence_for_RQ: Automates JUnit generation for Java/Spring and handles issues such as missing imports and private methods.

paper: Call-Chain-Aware LLM-Based Test Generation for Java Projects
evidence_for_RQ: Adds call-chain and dependency context and supports iterative fixing when test generation fails.
recommended_section: Task/context factors that may affect runnability.

paper: Context Matters: Improving the Practical Reliability of LLM-Based Unit Test Generation
evidence_for_RQ: Reports frequent compilation failures in real projects and identifies dependency/context-related failure causes.
recommended_section: Highly relevant failure taxonomy and threats-to-validity evidence.

paper: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucinations in Industrial LLM-based Unit Test Generation
evidence_for_RQ: Industrial study of hallucinations and compilation failures in LLM-based unit-test generation.

paper: MultiFileTest: A Multi-File-Level LLM Unit Test Generation Benchmark and Impact of Error Fixing Mechanisms
evidence_for_RQ: Evaluates 11 frontier LLMs across Python/Java/JavaScript and reports executability/cascade errors plus error-fixing scenarios.
recommended_section: Strong precedent for task difficulty and executability analysis.

paper: A Comparative Evaluation of ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Gemini in Automatic Unit Test Generation: a Success Rate Analysis
evidence_for_RQ: Directly compares ChatGPT and Gemini and measures execution success rate of generated unit tests.
recommended_section: Closest prior comparative evidence for the model pair in the RQ.

paper: Mutation-Guided Unit Test Generation With a Large Language Model
evidence_for_RQ: Evaluates an LLM-based unit-test generation approach with mutation-guided feedback.
